stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[4].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

create_post.statement: POST /posts with valid JSON title and body answers 201 and returns the post with id; GET /posts/{id} then returns it.

read_posts.statement: GET /posts lists all posts; GET /posts/{id} of an unknown id answers 404.

update_delete_post.statement: PUT replaces title and body; DELETE removes the post; both answer 404 for an unknown id and a deleted post is then 404.

api_key_required.statement: A request with a missing or wrong X-API-Key answers 401 on every route and leaves the database unchanged.

json_validation.statement: Malformed JSON, non-object bodies, missing, empty or non-string title/body answer 400 with a JSON error body; all responses carry Content-Type application/json.

bind_localhost_8080.statement: The default host is 127.0.0.1 and the default port is 8080; startup fails when BLOG_API_KEY is unset.

persistence_sqlite.statement: Posts survive a server restart on the same SQLite file.

stdlib_only.statement: blog_api.py imports only standard library modules (checked via sys.stdlib_module_names).
